profile.summary: Radici Studios is an art and education business founded by artist and teacher Jen Bloomer. It creates murals, prints and apparel on themes of human rights and connection, and leads creative workshops for children and adults. It has worked with schools, foundations and community organizations in the Bay Area.

review.notes: The privacy policy gives a Berkeley, CA 94709 P.O. box matching the agenda location, and the About page lists OUSD among its clients, alongside art workshops and education work that fit an Early Childhood Development services agreement. The summary is supported and neutral, and the named founder's email and the out-of-area phone number were correctly omitted.
